title: Cats
blurb: Purrs, paws, whiskers and the big cats of the wild

hr.title: Mačke
hr.blurb: Predenje, šape, brkovi i velike divlje mačke

questions.q: What is a baby cat called?
questions.fact: Kittens are born with their eyes shut and open them at one to two weeks old. Every kitten's eyes start out blue.

hr.q: Kako se zove mladunče mačke?
hr.fact: Mačići se rađaju zatvorenih očiju i otvore ih s jedan do dva tjedna. Svim mačićima oči su u početku plave.

questions.q: What is a group of kittens called?
questions.fact: A group of grown-up cats is called a clowder. A group of lions is a pride.

hr.q: Kako se zove skupina mačića koje je mačka okotila odjednom?
hr.fact: Na engleskom se skupina mačića zove 'kindle', a skupina odraslih mačaka 'clowder'.

questions.q: About how many hours a day does a typical house cat sleep?
questions.fact: Cats are liveliest at dawn and dusk, the best hunting hours for their wild relatives. The word for that is crepuscular.

hr.q: Otprilike koliko sati dnevno spava obična kućna mačka?
hr.fact: Mačke su najživahnije u zoru i u sumrak, kad njihovi divlji rođaci najbolje love.

questions.q: Which big cat lives in family groups called prides?
questions.fact: Lions are the only truly social wild cats. Most of a pride is related females and their cubs.

hr.q: Koja velika mačka živi u obiteljskim skupinama, čoporima?
hr.fact: Lavovi su jedine prave društvene divlje mačke. Čopor čine uglavnom srodne lavice i njihovi mladunci.

questions.q: What is the fastest land animal on Earth?
questions.fact: In a short sprint a cheetah can hit about 60 to 70 miles an hour, as fast as a car on the highway.

hr.q: Koja je najbrža kopnena životinja na Zemlji?
hr.fact: U kratkom sprintu gepard može postići oko 100 do 110 km/h, koliko i automobil na autocesti.

questions.q: Which big cat can purr but can't roar?
questions.fact: Cheetahs also chirp like birds to call to their cubs.

hr.q: Koja velika mačka može presti, ali ne može rikati?
hr.fact: Gepardi i cvrkuću poput ptica kad dozivaju svoje mladunce.

questions.q: How many toes does a typical cat have in all?
questions.fact: Five on each front paw and four on each back paw. Cats with extra toes are called polydactyl, and dozens live at writer Ernest Hemingway's old house in Key West, Florida.

hr.q: Koliko prstiju ukupno ima obična mačka?
hr.fact: Pet na svakoj prednjoj i četiri na svakoj stražnjoj šapi. Mačke s viškom prstiju zovu se polidaktilne, a desetci ih žive u nekadašnjoj kući pisca Ernesta Hemingwaya na Floridi.

questions.q: What do a cat's whiskers mostly help it do?
questions.fact: Whiskers are packed with nerves and can sense tiny changes in the air, which helps a cat find its way in the dark.

hr.q: Čemu mački uglavnom služe brkovi?
choices: Da osjeti što je oko nje
hr.fact: Brkovi su puni živaca i osjete sitne promjene u zraku, što mački pomaže snaći se u mraku.

questions.q: Which taste can't cats detect?
questions.fact: Cats are missing a working gene for tasting sweetness, so sugar doesn't taste sweet to them at all.

hr.q: Koji okus mačke ne mogu osjetiti?
hr.fact: Mačkama nedostaje ispravan gen za okus slatkoga, pa im šećer uopće nije sladak.

questions.q: Cats 'taste' smells with an organ in the roof of the mouth. What is it called?
questions.fact: When a cat uses it, it pulls a goofy open-mouthed face called the flehmen response.

hr.q: Mačke 'kušaju' mirise organom na nepcu. Kako se zove?
hr.fact: Kad ga mačka koristi, napravi smiješnu grimasu otvorenih usta koja se zove flemen.

questions.q: Which country has islands where cats far outnumber the people?
questions.fact: On Aoshima, one of Japan's famous cat islands, the cats far outnumber the few people who live there.

hr.q: Koja zemlja ima otoke na kojima mačaka ima mnogo više nego ljudi?
hr.fact: Na Aoshimi, jednom od slavnih japanskih mačjih otoka, mačaka je daleko više od ono malo ljudi koji ondje žive.

questions.q: Which cat breed is famous for having almost no fur?
questions.fact: Sphynx cats feel warm and soft, like suede. They need baths, because with no fur, oil builds up on their skin.

hr.q: Koja je pasmina mačaka poznata po tome što gotovo nema dlake?
hr.fact: Mačke sfinks tople su i meke na dodir, poput antilop-kože. Treba ih kupati jer im se bez dlake na koži skuplja masnoća.

questions.q: Which of these is one of the biggest house cat breeds?
questions.fact: The Maine Coon is the official state cat of Maine. The Singapura is one of the smallest breeds of all.

hr.q: Koja je od ovih jedna od najvećih pasmina kućnih mačaka?
hr.fact: Maine coon službena je mačka američke savezne države Maine. Singapura je jedna od najmanjih pasmina.

questions.q: Siamese kittens are born almost all white. What makes their ears and tail turn dark?
questions.fact: A Siamese cat's color gene only works where the body is cooler: the ears, face, paws and tail.

hr.q: Sijamski mačići rađaju se gotovo posve bijeli. Zašto im uši i rep potamne?
hr.fact: Gen za boju kod sijamske mačke djeluje samo gdje je tijelo hladnije: na ušima, licu, šapama i repu.

questions.q: In which country did people worship a cat-headed goddess named Bastet?
questions.fact: Ancient Egyptians loved cats so much that they mummified some of them and held huge festivals for Bastet.

hr.q: U kojoj su zemlji ljudi štovali božicu s mačjom glavom po imenu Bastet?
hr.fact: Stari Egipćani toliko su voljeli mačke da su neke mumificirali i održavali velike svečanosti u čast Bastet.

questions.q: In old Viking myths, the goddess Freyja rode in a chariot pulled by what?
questions.fact: Her other ride in the myths was a golden boar.

hr.q: U starim vikinškim mitovima, što je vuklo kola božice Freje?
hr.fact: U mitovima je jahala i zlatnog vepra.

questions.q: Which of these animals is NOT in the cat family?
questions.fact: Hyenas look a bit like dogs, but they're actually more closely related to cats!

hr.q: Koja od ovih životinja NIJE iz porodice mačaka?
hr.fact: Hijene pomalo nalikuju psima, ali su zapravo bliži rod mačkama!

questions.q: Which wild cat of North America is named for its short tail?
questions.fact: Bobcats live from southern Canada down to Mexico, including the woods of Georgia and South Carolina. They're about twice the size of a house cat.

hr.q: Koja divlja mačka Sjeverne Amerike ima kratak, podrezan rep?
hr.fact: Na engleskom se zove 'bobcat', baš po kratkom repu. Živi od južne Kanade do Meksika i otprilike je dvostruko veća od kućne mačke.

questions.q: What is it called when a cat pushes its paws in and out on something soft?
questions.fact: Kittens knead their mother to get the milk flowing. Grown cats keep doing it when they feel cozy. Some people call it making biscuits.

hr.q: Kako kažemo kad mačka šapama naizmjence gnječi nešto mekano?
hr.fact: Mačići gnječe mamu da potaknu mlijeko. Odrasle mačke to rade kad im je ugodno, pa kažemo da 'mijese kruh'.

questions.q: Why do cats' eyes shine in the dark?
choices: A mirror layer in the eye
questions.fact: The layer is called the tapetum lucidum. It bounces light back through the eye, so cats can see with far less light than we need.

hr.q: Zašto mačkama oči svijetle u mraku?
hr.fact: Taj se sloj zove tapetum lucidum. Odbija svjetlost natrag kroz oko, pa mačke vide uz mnogo manje svjetla nego mi.

questions.q: In bright light, what shape are a house cat's pupils?
questions.fact: Lions and tigers have round pupils, more like ours.

hr.q: Na jakom svjetlu, kakve su zjenice kućne mačke?
hr.fact: Lavovi i tigrovi imaju okrugle zjenice, sličnije našima.

questions.q: Which cartoon cat loves lasagna and hates Mondays?
questions.fact: Garfield first showed up in newspaper comics in 1978.

hr.q: Koji crtani mačak voli lazanje i mrzi ponedjeljke?
hr.fact: Garfield se prvi put pojavio u novinskim stripovima 1978.

questions.q: The oldest known pet cat lived about how long ago?
questions.fact: Archaeologists found a person and a cat buried side by side on the island of Cyprus about 9,500 years ago.

hr.q: Prije otprilike koliko je vremena živjela najstarija poznata kućna mačka?
hr.fact: Arheolozi su na Cipru pronašli čovjeka i mačku pokopane jedno uz drugo prije oko 9.500 godina.

questions.q: Cats spend up to how much of their awake time grooming?
questions.fact: A cat's tongue is covered in tiny hollow hooks that carry spit deep into the fur, like a built-in comb. Scientists at Georgia Tech figured that out.

hr.q: Koliko vremena dok su budne mačke najviše provode u dotjerivanju?
hr.fact: Mačji jezik prekriven je sitnim šupljim kukicama koje nose slinu duboko u krzno, poput ugrađenog češlja.

questions.q: Snow leopards wrap their long, fluffy tails around themselves to use as what?
questions.fact: Snow leopards live high in the mountains of Central Asia, where the tail also helps them balance on rocky cliffs.

hr.q: Snježni leopardi omotaju dugi, čupavi rep oko sebe. Čemu im tada služi?
hr.fact: Snježni leopardi žive visoko u planinama središnje Azije, gdje im rep pomaže i održati ravnotežu na liticama.

questions.q: Unlike most cats, which big cat loves to swim?
questions.fact: Tigers are the biggest wild cats in the world, and they often cool off in rivers and lakes.

hr.q: Za razliku od većine mačaka, koja velika mačka voli plivati?
hr.fact: Tigrovi su najveće divlje mačke na svijetu i često se rashlađuju u rijekama i jezerima.

questions.q: Which big cat lives in the Amazon rainforest?
questions.fact: A jaguar's spots, called rosettes, often have little dots in the middle. A leopard's usually don't.

hr.q: Koja velika mačka živi u amazonskoj prašumi?
hr.fact: Jaguarove pjege, rozete, često imaju točkicu u sredini. Leopardove je obično nemaju.

questions.q: The lucky cat statue that waves its paw in many shops comes from which country?
questions.fact: It's called maneki-neko, which means 'beckoning cat'. The raised paw is said to welcome in luck.

hr.q: Kip mačke koja maše šapom u mnogim trgovinama dolazi iz koje zemlje?
hr.fact: Zove se maneki-neko, što znači 'mačka koja doziva'. Podignuta šapa navodno priziva sreću.

questions.q: About how many times a second does a cat lap water with its tongue?
questions.fact: The tongue barely touches the water and pulls up a little column, and the cat snaps its mouth shut before it falls. MIT scientists filmed it in slow motion.

hr.q: Otprilike koliko puta u sekundi mačka zahvati vodu jezikom?
hr.fact: Jezik jedva dotakne vodu i povuče mali stupac, a mačka zatvori usta prije nego što on padne.

questions.q: Why do cats usually climb down trees tail first?
questions.fact: Curved claws grip great going up, but can't hold on going down headfirst.

hr.q: Zašto mačke obično silaze sa stabla stražnjicom naprijed?
hr.fact: Zakrivljene pandže odlično drže pri penjanju, ali ne mogu držati pri silasku glavom naprijed.

questions.q: If you could look under a tiger's fur, what would its skin look like?
questions.fact: No two tigers have exactly the same stripes.

hr.q: Kad bi zavirio ispod tigrova krzna, kakva bi mu bila koža?
hr.fact: Ne postoje dva tigra s potpuno jednakim prugama.

questions.q: Grown-up cats mostly meow to talk to whom?
questions.fact: Kittens meow to their mothers, but adult cats hardly ever meow at each other. They save it for us.

hr.q: S kim odrasle mačke uglavnom razgovaraju kad mijauču?
hr.fact: Mačići mijauču mami, ali odrasle mačke jedna drugoj gotovo nikad ne mijauču. To čuvaju za nas.

questions.q: A cat slowly blinks at you. What is it most likely saying?
questions.fact: Scientists found that if you slow-blink back, a cat is more likely to come over to you. Try it!

hr.q: Mačka ti polako trepne. Što ti najvjerojatnije poručuje?
hr.fact: Znanstvenici su otkrili da će ti mačka radije prići ako i ti njoj polako trepneš. Probaj!

questions.q: Calico cats, with patches of white, black and orange, are almost always what?
questions.fact: Orange cats are the opposite: about four out of five are boys. It all comes down to the X chromosome.

hr.q: Trobojne mačke, s bijelim, crnim i narančastim mrljama, gotovo su uvijek što?
hr.fact: Kod riđih mačaka je obrnuto: otprilike četiri od pet su mužjaci. Sve ovisi o X kromosomu.

questions.q: Scientists have a name for the zoomies, when a cat suddenly races around. What is it?
questions.fact: FRAP stands for Frenetic Random Activity Period. Dogs get them too!

hr.q: Znanstvenici imaju ime za trenutke kad mačka odjednom divlje jurca okolo. Kako se zove?
hr.fact: FRAP je engleska kratica za razdoblje mahnite, nasumične aktivnosti. I psi to imaju!

questions.q: Pet cats today are descended from which wild cat?
questions.fact: Wildcats probably moved in with early farmers to hunt the mice that raided their stored grain.

hr.q: Od koje divlje mačke potječu današnje kućne mačke?
hr.fact: Divlje mačke vjerojatno su se doselile kod prvih ratara da love miševe u spremištima žita.

questions.q: How many teeth does a grown-up cat have?
questions.fact: Kittens have 26 baby teeth. Grown-up dogs have 42.

hr.q: Koliko zuba ima odrasla mačka?
hr.fact: Mačići imaju 26 mliječnih zuba. Odrasli psi imaju 42.

questions.q: A lion's roar can be heard from about how far away?
questions.fact: That's about 8 kilometers. Lions roar to tell other lions, 'This is our land.'

hr.q: Otprilike s koje se udaljenosti može čuti rika lava?
hr.fact: Lavovi riču da drugim lavovima poruče: 'Ovo je naš teritorij.'

questions.q: In 1963, which country sent the first cat into space?
questions.fact: She was a Paris street cat named Félicette. Her capsule floated back to Earth by parachute, and today she has a statue in her honor.

hr.q: Koja je zemlja 1963. poslala prvu mačku u svemir?
hr.fact: Bila je to pariška ulična mačka Félicette. Njezina se kapsula vratila na Zemlju padobranom, a danas ima i svoj kip.

questions.q: A cat holds its tail straight up with a little hook at the top. How is it probably feeling?
questions.fact: A puffed-up, bristly tail means the opposite: the cat is scared and trying to look bigger.

hr.q: Mačka drži rep uspravno s malom kukicom na vrhu. Kako se vjerojatno osjeća?
hr.fact: Napuhan, nakostriješen rep znači suprotno: mačka je uplašena i želi izgledati veće.

questions.q: How many muscles does a cat have in each ear?
questions.fact: Each ear can swivel about 180 degrees on its own. People have just six muscles in each outer ear.

hr.q: Koliko mišića ima mačka u svakom uhu?
hr.fact: Svako se uho može samo zakrenuti za oko 180 stupnjeva. Ljudi imaju samo šest mišića u svakoj ušnoj školjci.

questions.q: What is a male cat called?
questions.fact: A female cat is called a queen.

hr.q: Kako se zove mužjak mačke?
hr.fact: Na engleskom se mačak zove 'tom', a mačka 'queen', kraljica.

questions.q: True or false: milk is a good drink for grown-up cats.
questions.fact: Most grown-up cats can't digest milk well, and it can upset their tummies. Fresh water is best.

hr.q: Točno ili netočno: mlijeko je dobro piće za odrasle mačke.
hr.fact: Većina odraslih mačaka ne probavlja dobro mlijeko i od njega ih može zaboljeti trbuh. Najbolja je svježa voda.

questions.q: Which grinning cat keeps disappearing in Alice's Adventures in Wonderland?
questions.fact: Lewis Carroll's book came out in 1865. Sometimes the cat vanishes until only its grin is left.

hr.q: Koja se nasmiješena mačka stalno pojavljuje i nestaje u Alisi u Zemlji čudesa?
hr.fact: Knjiga Lewisa Carrolla izašla je 1865. Ponekad mačka nestane sve dok ne ostane samo njezin osmijeh.

questions.q: What do you call the rumbling sound a happy cat makes?
questions.fact: Cats sometimes purr when they're nervous or hurt, too, maybe to calm themselves down.

hr.q: Kako se zove tiho brundanje koje ispušta sretna mačka?
hr.fact: Mačke ponekad predu i kad su nervozne ili ozlijeđene, možda da se same umire.
